action.why: Lifts the bench to the Lv 37–38 floor so Simon and Ninae take Advanced exams this chapter.

blessings.why: Avo +50 on the turn the center lane collapses on your group.
Halved damage for the turn the three named riders reach the line.

deploy.note: 10 slots: the Fortress spears hold the center for the three named riders; Nydine (Cavalry, the map's pick) and the fliers take the flanks. The other five level on Training Drills.

missables.text: Only equipped items came in: check each unit's kit on the transfer screen before the first battle.
missables.lose: Unequipped Part I gear until Part III
missables.recover: Part III storage returns it; nothing to do in Part II

people.text: Enemy here. His quest isn't on Theodora's route, so he never joins this War Path.
His Brezarant army holds the left lane: let it, and merge your left group into the center.

tips.text: Split three lanes: Bertrand's army left, your main group center, a small strike group right
Theodora and the walls lead the center: two of the three named riders come that way
End every turn on Thickets; Sofia and Bonaventure Physic the center from behind
Kill the west-side Warrior for his drop before he reaches Bertrand's line
